capabilities: Manage characters, locations, events, items, chapters, scenes, and books as linked notes
Plot events on chronology, Gantt, and calendar timelines with custom calendars
Draw and layer maps with entity tokens, GeoJSON/GPX overlays, and PNG export
Run campaign sessions with party HP, inventory, clocks, and session logs
Compile drafts through preset and custom export workflows
disambiguation: Not only a D&D campaign manager; campaign mode is one part of a broader story-planning, worldbuilding, and manuscript-compiling suite.
extras: Ships with English and Chinese translations; points to separate TEMPLATES_GUIDE.md, TRANSLATION_GUIDE.md, and a built-in tutorial in settings for details. In-app update highlights load screenshots from GitHub and i.ibb.co; no vault data is sent. Custom compile steps require writing JavaScript.
problem: Planning a story or running a campaign normally means scattering character sheets, timelines, maps, and manuscript drafts across separate tools instead of keeping them in the vault.
summary: Story and worldbuilding suite that manages characters, locations, events, maps, timelines, campaign sessions, and manuscript exports as Markdown notes.
